Hi! I'm Kartikey, a BCA AI & ML student at JECRC University, India. Skilled in Python, C++, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Machine Learning and Computer Vision. My team reached the Top 5 at SIH 2026 Prelims with ASTRA, an AI-powered astronaut activity recognition system.

Looking for passionate teammates skilled in AI/ML, Data Science, Astronomy, Robotics, UI/UX or Research. Let's build something innovative for space exploration! 🚀
